name: Homebox
description: Keep track of everything you own: where it is, receipts, warranties.
compose:
services:
  homebox:
    image: ghcr.io/sysadminsmedia/homebox:latest
    container_name: homebox
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:7745"
    environment:
      TZ: "{TZ}"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}/data:/data
